chapter_title: The Theft of the Rimet Cup
title: No Turning Back
subtitle: She never cared to understand why "enough is enough."

trails.title: A Stack of Newspaper
trails.description: A copy of newspaper that have been folded carelessly. Maybe its former owner is a hothead, you can tell from so many creases on the newspaper.

content.text:
{p}At 12pm today, the London police announced the new travel regulation Ban for Sailing on Thames(Temporary) is now going into effect. The ban was imposed to reduce the noises on the river and stops offenders from escaping on water. (Note: The ban has also clearly stated measures to deal with ships in red-and-white.)
{p}The host of the Flurry Puppy
Games has confirmed the
Games will take place in
Hyde Park. We have also
learned that the number of
athletes is unusually high
and their breeds are also
exceptionally distinctive.
At the moment, every training field close to the Park has been occupied; the athletes are enthusiastically preparing for the game. 
The first Give-Away shop in London has started business today. The shop is located in the alley at the back door of No. 17 Regent Street. Customers may find various of goods there, including Inspiration Bubble Water, the book Silent Spring, Pop Art signs. {img}

items.text: A good beginning doesn't bring a happy ending.
This theorem always holds true.

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: Finally, I'm back.

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: … 25 minutes and 38 seconds, huuhh! I can't believe I'm 15 minutes late.

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: Ugh! Blame it all on that bloody fire engine!

items.speaker: Ms. Acey
items.text: Still needs to work on your flexibility.

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: I'm trying, Ms. Acey.

items.speaker: Ms. Acey
items.text: Now, the final step.

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: Yes! The final step—take a photo of the reunion!
She reaches into Acey's belly and finally takes out a special camera.
Melania holds the camera with one hand, grasps The Heart of London with the other, and presses the shutter.
*Ka-chick*

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: Although there was a little challenge at the end, I was able to complete the answer sheet successfully.

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: Um, what if I enjoyed the photo shooting ...

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: Twitching eyebrows, stiff smile ...

items.speaker: Ms. Acey
items.text: You're like him.

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: No. I'll be better, Ms. Acey.

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: Unpredictable imagination won't be enough. A better plan with more details is also required. I won't let go one single minute until I accomplish the ultimate goal.

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: I became a thief late in life, so I'm not yet good at dealing with emergencies beyond the plan.

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: But, at least so far, I've given the correct answer to every question Father left.
She takes a thick black portfolio out of her handbag, turns to the last page, and solemnly sticks the photo she just took onto that page.

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: These are what Father used to protect.

items.speaker: Ms. Acey
items.text: You've done a great job.

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: Thank you, Ms. Acey.

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: There's only one question left, the key question …

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: The Rimet Cup.

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: If I recapture Father's memories and glories, is it enough to make up for his regrets?

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: Father ... Will he understand me?

items.speaker: Ms. Acey
items.text: Maybe you should meet him.

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: Okay.

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: It has been some time.

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: When the company went bankrupt, we couldn't even afford a decent cemetery.
She endeavors to find the right way out, but all paths and tombstones are blocked by the weeds that are half a man's height.

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: I wouldn't be surprised if a few wild animals jump out of nowhere in this desolation.
Squeak!

items.speaker: Ms. Acey
items.text: Excellent judgement.

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: Critters!

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: It seems they've made this place their playground.
They stare at The Heart of London held by Melania with greed.

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: Sorry. This is not the shiny crap you want.

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: It's on an important mission.

items.speaker: Ms. Acey
items.text: Be careful.

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: Phew! It's a rather wise decision to carry around Zizz Popping Nuts.
The critters scatter, kick away the broken rocks, and step over the weeds. Melania finally finds the relatively tidy tombstone.

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: Father ...

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: I brought The Heart of London for you.

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: Do you remember it?

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: That dim thief got sidetracked by the surprising slug spray and broke into the security room with it.

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: After that, he turned over a new leaf, and things unattended have never come to his mind.

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: But what I'm going to face is completely different from a poor little thief.

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: That new security company had carefully arranged robots. They took action by the book and were heavily guarded, but there's no creativity in their defense. All actions were exactly as they were in the Guidance on Security.

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: Not even as surprising as a fire engine.

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: It should be the best of times for thieves.
She collects that gem, blows away the dust on it, and puts it back into the envelope.

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: I'm sorry. I can't leave it to you. It needs to be sent to Sergeant William's office tomorrow evening on time. As evidence, it's quite important.

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: But I have some interesting news.
Melania takes out the worn-out World Soccer and gently puts it in front of the tombstone.

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: The world seems to have changed a lot.

items.speaker: Reporter
items.text: Today we have Mr. Iverson from the New Humans Company, which provides security services for the soon arriving Rimet Cup.

items.speaker: Reporter
items.text: As an experienced head of the company, he would love to share the stories of the Rimet Cup with us.

items.speaker: Reporter
items.text: Years ago, the Rimet Cup was under the protection of the most well-known security company, Ramirez, but magically disappeared overnight.

items.speaker: Reporter
items.text: It only took one day for Ramirez to retrieve the cup. This flourishing company received waves of compliments, and people were celebrating the story of a false alarm ...

items.speaker: Iverson
items.text: Everyone, including us, thought Ramirez defended their reputation.

items.speaker: Iverson
items.text: But unfortunately, evidence from the verification agency showed that the Rimet Cup they brought back was a counterfeit.

items.speaker: Iverson
items.text: They were confronted with the pressure of forgery suspect and the disappointment from all the peers ... The imagination of Ramirez caused catastrophic havoc to the whole society.

items.speaker: Iverson
items.text: We then have to put aside the security theory held by Ramirez and return to the more science-based and reliable Guidance on Security.

items.speaker: Iverson
items.text: As it turns out, any security theories without regulations are castles in the air. Humph! It's a pure joke.

items.speaker: Ms. Acey
items.text: Heh.

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: Heh. What a sharp comment.

items.speaker: Iverson
items.text: Security measures require prebuilt plan, advanced equipment, and reliable personnel. Ridiculous imagination is the last thing.

items.speaker: Iverson
items.text: The ideal answer to all of these can be taken from the New Humans security robots.

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: Father, when you were assigned the mission to protect the Rimet Cup, did you ever imagine such a day would come?

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: If we had conducted a quality check on that "Rimet Cup" after receiving it, if we had investigated the transaction records of the client company, if we had verified the list of the patrol officers ...

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: Perhaps I would not be talking to your silent tomb today.
Melania pats the tombstone, just like comforting an old friend who is distressed because of his bumpy career.

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: Cheer up, Father.

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: I will prove it all, even if it'll lead me to a path different from yours.

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: Real protection is more than defense. It's about attack.

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: Mr. Iverson needs to learn a harsher lesson.
TO BE CONTINUED ...
